title: Twelve unit cubes in a cube of side 2.9315: soft-to-rigid packing
description:
A packing of 12 unit cubes in a cube of side 2.9315185094797 (displayed 2.93151+), below the previous best known 2.9327717687048653 (H. Lin, July 2026). Every pair of cubes and every wall is at least 1e-6 apart. Found by a soft-to-rigid homotopy (balls compressed in a shrinking box and hardened into cubes under continued inward pressure), tightened by constrained optimization, and certified in exact rational arithmetic.

Contents: claim file in the format of the current record file (one [x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz] pose per cube), a 30-line verifier, an exact certificate, 2D and 3D simulators, the paper (LaTeX and PDF), and the full experiment log.

Code, experiments and verification were developed with Claude (Anthropic).
